cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix it now. Leave those minutes overnight; I'll collect them as yesterday.

reason: Make A credit concession concrete by repairing first and collecting matured time later; remove the abstract currency-maturing tag and rank wrapper.
